title: T-RECAP Phase 2 telemetry and command packet layout schema
description: Validates the hand-written DDR/UDP packet and PC-command source-of-truth JSON consumed by the R1 generated-header flow.

const.name: seq
const.semantics: PC-visible normal telemetry sequence; WRAP and diagnostic STATUS do not consume normal sequence numbers

const.name: payload_bytes
const.semantics: valid payload bytes after header; DDR alignment padding excluded

const.name: version
const.semantics: required value 1 for a version-1 request and required value 2 for a version-2 request; version 1 accepts command types 0x0001..0x0007 and version 2 accepts 0x0001..0x000E

const.name: SET_THR2

args.arg1: THR2[55:32] in low 24 bits; upper bits zero

const.action: write THR2_LO, write THR2_HI, pulse THR2_COMMIT

const.name: SET_SOURCE_MODE
const.action: write SOURCE_MODE_SHADOW and pulse SOURCE_MODE_COMMIT under source-mode change rule

args.arg0: PACKET_ENABLE bit mask with reserved and reserved-disabled bits zero

const.name: PING
const.action: return a fresh diagnostic STATUS only; no command-result packet and no non-PING sequence-ledger change

const.name: SET_TELEMETRY_ENABLE
const.action: transactionally disable or enable telemetry transport

const.name: CONFIGURE_DDR_RING
const.action: configure the canonical trusted HPS runtime DDR ring tuple and leave telemetry disabled

const.name: RESET_TRANSPORT
const.action: transactionally reset transport and enter reconfiguration-required state

const.name: CLEAR_COUNTERS
const.action: pulse FPGA transport diagnostic counter clear

const.name: START_BRAM_REPLAY
const.action: pulse the retained BRAM replay request/admission path and report retained accept or reject evidence

const.name: READ_STATUS_VERSION
const.action: read raw FPGA STATUS and VERSION and return a NOOP command result

const.name: seq
const.semantics: echoes the version-2 non-PING request sequence

const.name: fpga_status
const.semantics: raw post-attempt TCSR_STATUS, or zero when unreadable

const.name: csr_version
const.semantics: raw post-attempt TCSR_VERSION, or zero when unreadable

x-trecap-semantic-checks: numeric magic constants are compared after little-endian integer parsing
header fields shall occupy exactly 32 bytes without implicit padding
one UDP datagram shall carry one header plus payload and exclude DDR alignment padding
normal payload sizes shall satisfy 32 + payload_bytes <= 1200
WAVE payload shall satisfy payload_bytes = 16 + 6 * nsamp and 1 <= nsamp <= 192
SPEC129, SPEC64, METRICS, STATUS, and WRAP payload byte counts shall match the exact Revision G values
METRICS shall set exactly one metrics-class flag and payload_scaled shall be zero
reserved-disabled PEAKS and DEBUG shall not be emitted unless a later explicit extension replaces their undefined payload contract
